title: Semi-discrete Active Flux method for two-dimensional hyperbolic systems with Coriolis source terms
summary: We investigate the semi-discrete Active Flux numerical method on Cartesian grids applied to two-dimensional linear and nonlinear shallow water equations with Coriolis source terms. These hyperbolic systems admit non-trivial stationary solutions governed by a geostrophic equilibrium. In this setting, we analyze the stationarity-preserving properties of our semi-discrete Active Flux formulation. To do so for the linear system, we apply a discrete spatial Fourier transform to the semi-discrete method and analyze the resulting evolution matrix.
